description:
S06 E12 — Thank God for Scoliosis
Charlie and Jake fight for the affections of a waitress, while Alan fights sexual tension with his receptionist.

title: Two and a Half Men
description:
S06 E13 — I Think You Offended Don
Judith is pregnant with a baby girl, and Alan is convinced he is the father; Jake is in a contentious mood, and Charlie thinks he knows why.

title: Two and a Half Men
description:

Convinced that Alan is not appreciated by his family, Melissa asks him to live with her and her mother.

title: Two and a Half Men
description:
S06 E15 — I'd Like to Start With the Cat
In an attempt to prove he has changed from his old self, Charlie agrees to go with Chelsea to couples counseling.

title: Two and a Half Men
description:

When Charlie swears his love to Chelsea (Jennifer Taylor), her response is nothing like what he'd expected.

title: Two and a Half Men
description:
S06 E18 — My Son's Enormous Head
Charlie fights the overwhelming urge to flee when Chelsea gets sick, and he is forced to take care of her.

title: Two and a Half Men
description:
S06 E19 — The Two Finger Rule
Chelsea finds pictures of a naked woman on Charlie's phone.

title: Two and a Half Men
description:
S06 E20 — Hello, I Am Alan Cousteau
Evelyn finally meets Charlie and Chelsea.

title: Two and a Half Men
description:
S06 E21 — Above Exalted Cyclops
Chelsea sets Alan up on a blind date with Rose.

title: Two and a Half Men
description:
S06 E22 — Sir Lancelot's Litter Box
Alan finds there is not much room for him left in the house when Charlie reluctantly lets Chelsea move in.

title: Two and a Half Men
description:
S06 E23 — Good Morning Mrs. Butterworth
When Chelsea and Alan become best friends, Charlie tries to take advantage of the situation.

title: Any Given Sunday
description: A football head coach (Al Pacino) and an aging quarterback (Dennis Quaid) clash with the new, contemporary, money-oriented owner (Cameron Diaz) of their team.

title: Any Given Sunday
description: A football head coach (Al Pacino) and an aging quarterback (Dennis Quaid) clash with the new, contemporary, money-oriented owner (Cameron Diaz) of their team.

title: Boogie
description: Alfred "Boogie" Chin is a basketball phenom who dreams of playing in the NBA. As his parents pressure him to earn a scholarship to college, Boogie must also navigate a new girlfriend, high school, on-court rivals and the burden of expectation.

title: A Thousand and One
description: Unapologetic and free-spirited Inez kidnaps her 6-year-old son, Terry, from the foster care system. They set out to reclaim their sense of home, identity and stability in a rapidly changing New York City.

title: Blue Bayou
description: Struggling to make a better life for his family in the Louisiana bayou, a Korean adoptee must confront the ghosts of his past after learning that he could be deported from the only country he's ever called home.

title: The Hunger Games
description: A resourceful teen takes her younger sister's place in a brutal contest in which youths from each of 12 districts fight to the death on live television.

title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
description: After their unprecedented victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark embark on a Victors Tour. Katniss senses rebellion is stirring, but a cruel change in the upcoming 75th Hunger Games may change Panem forever.

title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
description: After shattering the games forever, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) finds herself in District 13, fighting to save Peeta (Josh Hutcherson) and a nation moved by her courage.

title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
description: Katniss faces mortal traps, deadly enemies and moral choices when she and her closest friends leave District 13 to assassinate President Snow and liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem.

title: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
description: With the annual Hunger Games approaching, 18-year-old Coriolanus Snow is assigned to mentor Lucy Gray Baird. Uniting their instincts for showmanship and political savvy, they race against time to ultimately reveal who's a songbird and who's a snake.

title: Kajillionaire
description: Two con artists have spent 26 years training their only daughter to swindle, scam and steal at every turn. During a desperate and hastily conceived heist, they charm a stranger into joining them, only to have their entire world turned upside down.

title: Cocktail Wars
description:
S01 E01 — A Hot and Cold War
Lance Bass, Joey Fatone and mixology expert Melissa Brooke welcome Justin Sylvester to the bar as they challenge the mixologists to battle extreme temperature shifts.

title: Cocktail Wars
description:
S01 E02 — A Jersey Vacation
The Real Housewives of New Jersey's Melissa Gorga delivers sweet critiques as the mixologists explore the many cocktails of vacation, starting with the Espresso Martini, at Melissa's request of course.

title: Cocktail Wars
description:
S01 E03 — The Perfect Pour
Our mixology expert, Melissa Brooke, takes us back to the basics with a series of challenges meant to test our mixologists' skills, while Lance and Joey bring along an old friend to join the fun - actor, producer and writer Seth Green.

title: Cocktail Wars
description:
S01 E04 — The Ultimate Flavor Face Off
USA's Everything on the Menu host Braun Strowman stops by to enjoy a flavor explosion on Cocktail Wars, and we find out what the strongest human we know thinks about our menu.

title: Dirty Rotten Scandals
description:
S01 E03 — America's Next Top Model Pt. 1
In 2003, supermodel Tyra Banks broke into the world of reality TV; ANTM offered women from all over the country the promise of fame and fortune, but the aspiring models soon realize they may be collateral damage on the show's path to popularity.

title: Dirty Rotten Scandals
description:
S01 E04 — America's Next Top Model Pt. 2
As ANTM becomes more popular, it pulls in more seemingly vulnerable girls; some hopeful contestants claim they were treated increasingly poorly, leading to allegations of lasting trauma from what they endured on the show.

title: Dirty Rotten Scandals
description:
S01 E05 — The Price is Right Pt. 1
America loved Bob Barker, but few knew about the scandal behind the scenes at The Price is Right; former employees break decades of silence, exposing a hidden affair and secrets that reveal a darker side of television's most beloved game show icon.

title: Dirty Rotten Scandals
description:
S01 E06 — The Price is Right Pt. 2
Bob Barker retaliates against model Holly Hallstrom after she refuses to testify on his behalf, triggering a decade-long legal war; as mass firings and new allegations surface, Barker's power is exposed and the women who stood up are finally heard.
